{{Quote|This way.|The handmaiden, speaking to Ahsoka Tano and Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>}}
This '''handmaiden''' was present at a [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
She and [[Unidentified Handmaiden 1|another handmaiden]] worked for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] and helped [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] get past the droid controls by distracting the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|droid's]] attention. She was later seen traveling with Bonteri to [[Bonteri house/Legends|her house]].
